annotation.title_clean: Guidelines 03/2026 on web scraping in the context of generative AI
annotation.title_en: Guidelines 03/2026 on web scraping in the context of generative AI
annotation.summary_en: EDPB guidelines, adopted for public consultation in July 2026, explaining how the GDPR applies to private-sector web scraping for training generative AI. They cover controller roles, purpose limitation, transparency, minimisation, accuracy, legitimate interest balancing and special categories of data, with mitigating measures.
key_provisions_or_claims: GDPR applies to web scraping that involves personal data processing.
Legitimate interest requires three cumulative conditions: legitimate interest, necessity and balancing test.
Data minimisation measures include collection criteria, filtering, excluding opposing websites, and synthetic or anonymised data.
Individual notification may be waived if impossible or disproportionate effort.
Incidental collection of special categories may be justified under C-136/17 with effective safeguards.
